criteria.requirement: Repair both BaseForm.process extra_filters and Form.validate extra_validators as one caller-ownership bug family. Before appending an inline rule, copy only that used field sequence; do not mutate caller lists, deep-copy callable objects, reorder explicit-extra before inline, or eagerly consume unrelated unused extra-field generators. Support list/tuple sequences, repeat construction/process/validate, inheritance and real error propagation. Each inline runs once per current processing/validation cycle. Preserve all original field/validator semantics and leave already-correct default behavior unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
